description: Search1API provides web search, news search, page crawling, sitemap discovery, trending feeds, screenshots, extraction, and deep crawling for AI agents and applications. It also offers hosted agent interfaces such as an MCP server and a terminal CLI built on the same service.
summary: Search1API exposes a REST API at `api.search1api.com` with a public OpenAPI spec, a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at `mcp.search1api.com/mcp`, and a first-party `s1` CLI; authentication is via Search1API OAuth 2.1 or Search1API API keys depending on surface/client support.
